blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A galaxy is a massive gravitational system consisting of billions of stars, gas, and dust.
Our Solar System is situated within the Milky Way galaxy, which appears as a glowing band in the night sky.
The Milky Way has an estimated diameter of about 100,000 light years and contains 100–400 billion stars.
The Sun is located specifically in the Orion Arm of the Milky Way.

blocks.content: Our Solar System lies in the Milky Way galaxy. It appears as a glowing band in the night sky.

items: The specific location of the Sun within the Milky Way (Orion Arm) is frequently tested.
Memorize the diameter of the Milky Way galaxy: Approximately 100,000 light years.
Note the estimated number of stars in the Milky Way: 100–400 billion.
